details.title: Master Services Agreement
details.governing_law: laws of the State of New York
details.courts_or_seat: state and federal courts in New York County

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts in New York County have exclusive jurisdiction.

details.parties_quote: Orion Retail Partners Inc., an Ohio corporation having its principal office at 40 East Broad Street, Columbus, Ohio 43215 ("Orion"); and AtliQ Inc, a Delaware corporation having its principal office at 101 College Road East, Suite 210, Princeton, New Jersey 08540 ("Vendor").

payment_source.quote: Orion shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt.

details.services_summary: Data engineering and business intelligence services for store-level sales reporting.

liability_cap.basis: fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months before the claim
liability_cap.quote: Each party's total liability under this Agreement is limited to the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months before the claim, except for fraud or wilful misconduct.

delay_penalty.quote: If Vendor is late with a milestone for reasons within its control, Orion's sole remedy is a credit of one percent (1%) of that milestone's fee per week of delay, capped at five percent (5%) of the milestone fee. No credit applies where delay is caused by Orion, by a change in scope or by events outside Vendor's reasonable control.
